title: Pure Sunavalon
summary: The Sunavalon family only: Sunseed, Sunvine and Sunavalon, all EARTH Plants, with staples. Aromaseraphy Jasmine stays as the one outside card, because the page's combo runs through it; Aromage Laurel and the Rikka and Therion engines are left out. Every Sunavalon Link Monster has 0 ATK and can't be attacked, and Dryas, Dryades and Dryanome gain back damage you take and summon a Sunvine Link from the Extra Deck. Sunseed Genius Loci links into Sunavalon Dryas in the Extra Monster Zone, which then searches a Sunvine Spell/Trap. Sunvine Sowing, the newest card, summons a Sunseed from the Deck and deals you the 1000 damage that triggers them, and Sunvine Shrine revives a Plant Normal Monster every turn. Sunseed Shadow and Sunseed Twin copy or revive your Links. The tree climbs through Sunavalon Melias and Sunavalon Dryanome to Sunavalon Dryatrentiay, which tributes a linked monster to destroy that many cards. Sunavalon Bloom negates their face-up monsters when activated with a Link-4 Plant on your field.
main: Plant Normal Monster: the only material for Sunavalon Dryas.
Summons itself next to a Plant Normal; copies a small Link from the Extra Deck.
Revives a Plant Normal next to a Sunavalon; revives a Plant Link with a same-name twin in the GY.
Hand trap: negates an effect that targets your Extra Deck Plant.
Newest: summons a Sunseed from the Deck; protects a Plant Link from the GY.
Revives a Plant Normal each turn; locks the Extra Deck to Plants.
Tributes a Link Monster to revive a Plant.
Negates their face-up monsters on activation with a Link-4 Plant out; pumps a Plant Link.
